newsitem.title: GREECE: ITT-SHERATON CMN TO HOLD TALKS ON ATHENS HOTEL-SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: ITT-SHERATON CMN TO HOLD TALKS ON ATHENS HOTEL-SOURCE.

text.p: ITT-Sheraton Chairman John Kapiolta arrives in Athens on Wednesday to hold talks with the state National Bank of Greece and other major shareholders of Grande Bretagne Hotel, a U.S source told Reuters.
ITT-Sheraton is the majority shareholder of Athens' landmark Grande Bretagne Hotel and would like to increase its stake, the source said.
Grande Bretagne was supposed to undergo a major renovation in late 1996 or early 1997.

But ITT-Sheraton corporation is weighing whether to close down the hotel for renovation works in late 1997 or do it gradually without ceasing operations completely. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
